slides.title: M ake Large Language Models S maller Quantization
slides.text: M ake Large Language Models S maller Quantization - reduce precision (16, 8, 4 bits) – almost without losing accuracy (~3 %) Mixed-precision quantization - go down to 2.5bits average. Pruning - removing unnecessary (small) weights from the model Train smaller model (70, 30, 13, 7 Bln parameters) Knowledge distillation - training a smaller model on the outputs of a larger model (like an adult teaching a child). ChatGPT runs on powerful servers which cost ~ $500K each. There are ways to make model smaller to run on a laptop or cell phone
